sections.body:
The Corner Table began as a small kitchen with a big table. Today it is a neighbourhood restaurant and bar where regulars and first-timers share wood-fired pizza, handmade pasta, grills, curries and a long list of drinks.

We cook from scratch, buy from nearby suppliers when we can, and keep the music live on weekends. There is a private dining room for groups, parking, and step-free access throughout.

privacy.label: Privacy policy
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
The Corner Table respects your privacy. This page explains what we collect and why.

## What we collect
- Details you give us when you book, join the queue, buy tickets, order, enquire or send a message: name, contact details, party size and notes.
- Preferences you choose to share, such as dietary needs and occasions.
- Basic technical information needed to keep the site working and secure.

## How we use it
- To run your booking, order or ticket, and to contact you about it.
- To look after you better on future visits, where you have agreed.
- To send news or offers only if you have agreed. You can stop at any time.

## Keeping and sharing
We keep your details only as long as we need them for these purposes or the law requires. We do not sell your data. We share it only with services that help us run the restaurant, under their own privacy duties.

## Your rights
You can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data from the My data page, or by contacting us. We answer requests promptly.

## Contact
Use the Contact page for any privacy question.

terms.label: Terms and conditions
terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.body:
These terms apply when you use the The Corner Table website and services.

## Using the site
Please use the site lawfully and give accurate details when you book, order or send a message.

## Bookings, tickets and orders
Bookings, tickets and orders are governed by the booking policy and refund policy shown on this site. Prices and availability can change; the price shown when you order is the price you pay.

## Menu and allergens
We take care with allergen information but cannot guarantee any dish is free of an allergen. Tell your server about any allergy.

## Changes
We may update these terms. The version on this page is the one that applies.

## Contact
Questions about these terms can be sent through the Contact page.

refund-policy.label: Refund policy
refund-policy.title: Refund policy
refund-policy.body:
## Event tickets
Tickets can be cancelled and refunded according to the cancellation terms shown when you bought them. If we cancel an event, you receive a full refund.

## Online orders
If there is a problem with your order, contact us as soon as you can and we will make it right or refund the affected items.

## Gift cards
Gift cards are not exchanged for cash. A cancelled card cannot be used.

## How refunds are paid
Refunds go back to the original payment method where possible.

cookies.label: Cookie policy
cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.body:
## What we store on your device
This site keeps small items on your device so that it works: for example, to remember your booking or queue place on this device. They are not used to track you across other sites.

## Analytics
Visit statistics are collected only if the restaurant has switched them on in its privacy settings.

## Your choices
You can clear stored data in your browser at any time. Some features, such as remembering a booking, will then start again.

accessibility.label: Accessibility statement
accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.body:
The Corner Table wants everyone to be able to use this website and enjoy the restaurant.

## This website
We aim for pages that work with a keyboard and screen reader, have readable contrast and text that can be enlarged.

## The restaurant
Please contact us before you visit about step-free access, seating, accessible toilets, or any help you need. We will do our best to arrange it.

## Feedback
If you find something hard to use, tell us through the Contact page and we will work to fix it.

faqs.title: How do I book a table?
faqs.body: Use Book a table on this site, or call us. For groups of nine or more, use the private dining form.

faqs.title: What are your opening hours?
faqs.body: We are open every day from 11:00 to 23:00. On Sundays we serve brunch from 10:00 to 15:30 and dinner from 18:00.

faqs.title: Do you take walk-ins?
faqs.body: Yes. Join the walk-in queue from your phone, or ask at the door.

faqs.title: Is there parking?
faqs.body: There is street parking nearby and a small car park behind the building.

faqs.title: Is the restaurant wheelchair accessible?
faqs.body: Yes. There is step-free access to every dining area. Tell us before you visit if you need anything else.

faqs.title: Do you cater for dietary needs?
faqs.body: Yes. The menu marks vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free dishes, and every allergen is listed. Tell your server about any allergy.

faqs.title: Are children welcome?
faqs.body: Very. We have high chairs, a smaller menu on request and colouring sheets.

faqs.title: Do you have a private dining room?
faqs.body: Yes, for up to twenty-four guests. It suits birthdays, family gatherings and corporate dinners.

faqs.title: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
faqs.body: Yes. Use Order online to choose pickup or delivery and see the fees before you pay.

faqs.title: Can I buy a gift card?
faqs.body: Yes. Gift cards are on the Gift cards page and arrive by email straight away.

faqs.title: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.body: Cancel up to two hours before your booking at no charge. Later cancellations and no-shows may be recorded.

posts.title: Our autumn menu, dish by dish
posts.excerpt: What is new, what stays, and why the squash soup is back.
posts.body:
## What changed

The cooler weather brings roasted squash, wild mushrooms and slow braises to the menu. The pumpkin and ginger soup is back by popular demand.

## What stays

The wood-fired pizzas and handmade pasta stay exactly as they are, because you told us to leave them alone.

posts.title: Meet the team behind the pass
posts.excerpt: Five people, forty years of kitchen experience between them.
posts.body:
## Who is in the kitchen

Our kitchen is led by a head chef who trained in two countries, supported by a sous chef who runs the grill and a pastry cook who bakes before sunrise.

## Out front

Our floor team knows the menu, the regulars and the wine list. Ask them anything.

posts.title: How we source our ingredients
posts.excerpt: Short supply chains, honest prices and a few good farmers.
posts.body:
## Close to home

Vegetables, dairy and eggs come from farms within a day's drive. Fish arrives twice a week.

## What we will not buy

Anything we cannot trace back to a person we have met.

posts.title: Live music is back on weekends
posts.excerpt: Friday jazz, Saturday acoustic and a Sunday brunch band.
posts.body:
## The line-up

Friday is a jazz quartet. Saturday is acoustic guitar and vocals. Sunday brunch has a small band that plays quietly enough to talk over.

## Booking

Tables near the stage go quickly. Book ahead or join the walk-in queue.

posts.title: Cocktails for everyone, including zero-proof
posts.excerpt: Our bar list now has as many mocktails as cocktails.
posts.body:
## Zero-proof, taken seriously

Our mocktails get the same fresh juice, house syrups and garnishes as the cocktails.

## Our favourites

The passion fruit iced tea, strawberry lemonade and watermelon cooler are the most ordered.

posts.title: A guide to private dining
posts.excerpt: Rooms, menus, timings and how to plan a smooth evening.
posts.body:
## The room

Our private dining room seats up to twenty-four, with its own entrance and a dedicated host.

## Planning

Tell us your date, group size and any dietary needs. We reply with a menu and a quote within a day.
